Got for tuner for my son. Love it. this is better than my snark. I paid so much for a tuner years ago now it’s free on your phone and it sounds excellent and it’s actually easier a child could do it.
Ike tuner. NOT FREE-billed me twice for the same time period!
$5 a week is outrageous. Barely any free content and the subscription model is very pushy and annoying. Plus $5 a week is an absolutely insane price to pay for an app

Annual Fee. Didn’t know I would be paying $5.36 weekly (385.92 annually) for an app that doesn’t teach you much and kind of sucks. I really only downloaded for free tuner which isn’t actually free. Could understand a little bit more if there was lesson where notes automatically changed if you played the right tune but they don’t have that. Would not recommend.

Tuned 3 strings. I was able to tune 3 of the strings, but when it got to the last one, it snapped. Amazing. Don’t recommend.

All chords sound the same?. So this is a visually nice app but has a major flaw. It teaches you cords (looks great, easy yo visualize) but there is also a “sound” icon that you would press to hear the different cords that go along with the diagram. Problem is the sounds do not switch along with the cords. Every now and then you can get the sound to play the appropriate cord. So essentially, every cord sounds EXACTLY the same. That can’t be right.
Very easy. The only reason I give a four is because it would be nice if the tuning tone was a little louder.
amazing. Helped so much makin my ukulele sound better!

Works so far. Works decently so far. There are some initial ads, and the string keeps defaulting to C, so I tune the C string first and then it stops.

Pure annoyance. Only two things are free. Tuning, and a C chord. Anytime you try to do anything else you get an ad asking you to upgrade.I don’t mind an occasional ad, and I don’t mind that there are in app purchases, but don’t advertise it’s just having in app purchases when really you have to buy the entire app to get any use out of it.
Amazing product. This is a great app. Get to the exact point yes, yes yes.
Too many pop up advertisements. While trying to tune a ukulele, an advertisement popped up. If you like to watch many ads, if you want to tune a uke, get something else.
